_comment: STUB fingerprint library for reuse detection. In production, `fingerprint` would be an embedding produced by an audio model (e.g. a CNN over a mel-spectrogram). Here they are hand-authored 8-dim vectors so the demo is deterministic and the confidence bands are reproducible. riddimId is the onchain RiddimRegistry id the match maps to once that riddim is registered.

samples.title: Lagos Nights (Refix)
samples.note: Near-identical reuse of Lagos Nights — expected HIGH confidence.
